_doc: Real-device benchmark gates, checked by scripts/ci_test_report.py --gates. Keyed by the benchmark JSON's context.build.device; a device not listed (CI's emulator, other phones) is reported, never gated. A gate is the reference median (or percentile) times (1 + margin). References: docs/app/TESTING.md, 'Pixel 6 against the CI emulator'.
_state: A result is gated only if its test ran at or below maxThermalStatus (PowerManager; 0 = none) and on a charger, at start and end, as recorded in *deviceState.json (TD-135). abMargin: scripts/startup_ab.py fails a candidate whose pooled median is more than this over the reference build's, run interleaved on the same phone.
